query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

message.content:
Here's a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

**Farewell, Stephen! 🎉**

They say the best engineers don't just write code—they write *legacy*. Stephen, you've done both, and somehow found time to shitpost memes at a level that should probably be in your job title.

You were the rare engineer who could debug production at 3am *and* drop the perfect meme in #general at 3:01am. Your code was clean, your commit messages were *suspiciously* professional, and your meme game? Absolutely unhinged. We respect the range. 

The team won't be the same without your technical brilliance, your calm under fire, and your uncanny ability to find a SpongeBob meme for literally every sprint retrospective. You've set a bar so high, we're pretty sure it's in low Earth orbit now.

Go forth and build amazing things, post legendary memes, and remember: you can check out anytime you like, but you can never leave our group chat. 😉

**Stay memey, stay brilliant, and don't forget us little people when you're changing the world.**

*Your fellow code warriors* 🚀

---

P.S. — We archived your best memes. They're company IP now. Legal says hi.

---
